newsitem.title: CANADA: TLC The Laser Center sets C$25.3 mln issue.
newsitem.headline: TLC The Laser Center sets C$25.3 mln issue.

text.p: TLC The Laser Center Inc said on Tuesday that a group of underwriters have agreed to buy 3.5 million common shares at a price of C$7.25 per share.
The offering is expected to yield gross proceeds of C$25.3 million, TLC said in a statement.
The company said it will file a final prospectus today in Ontario and in all other provinces on Wednesday. The offering is scheduled to close October 2.
The underwriting group is led by RBC Dominion Securities Inc.
